author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Schwarber to participate in Home Run Derby
desc: Kyle Schwarber announced that he's in Monday night's Home Run Derby.
impact: Schwarber will join Bryce Harper in their home ball park. He leads all of baseball with 32 home runs this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connelly Early confirmed to be dealing with posterior elbow inflammation
desc: Connelly Early went for a second opinion that confirmed the diagnosis of posterior elbow inflammation/irritation.
impact: It is nothing more serious for Early, which is a positive sign. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyler Fedko officially optioned by Twins
desc: The Twins optioned Kyler Fedko to Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Fedko returns to Triple-A with Ryan Jeffers activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Jeffers (hand) activated from IL
desc: The Twins activated Ryan Jeffers from the injured list.
impact: Jeffers rejoined the Twins on Thursday. He'll be back for the final series before the All-Star break.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jose Cuas optioned to Triple-A
desc: Jose Cuas was sent back to Triple-A Omaha on Friday.
impact: Cuas will clear the way for Eli Morgan to be called up and rejoin the Royals' pen. Cuas has performed mostly well since being last called up, but he's made five relief appearances in the last nine days. In that span, the 32-year-old righty has allowed just two runs while striking out nine across 6 1/3 innings.

author: Nate Miller
title: Eli Morgan recalled on Friday
desc: Eli Morgan was called up from Triple-A ahead of Friday's game against the Orioles.
impact: Morgan has struggled a bit in the majors so far this season, but he's earned his way back up with excellent work at Triple-A. In the minors this year, Morgan has posted a 1.42 ERA with 31 strikeouts across 19 innings. He's also collected three saves.

author: Nate Miller
title: Kameron Misner sent to minors
desc: Kameron Misner was optioned to Triple-A on Friday.
impact: With Vinnie Paquantino (hand) set to return to the Royals' lineup, Misner will head back to the minors. Misner has played in 18 games for the Royals this season, posting just a .500 OPS with four RBI and three steals over 44 plate appearances.

author: Nate Miller
title: Vinnie Paquantino (hand) back with Royals on Friday
desc: Vinnie Paquantino (hand) was activated from the IL ahead of Friday's game in Baltimore.
impact: Paquantino's stint on the shelf lasted just under a month, as the 28-year-old slugger has been out of action since June 13. Kameron Misner was optioned to Triple-A in a corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) could deal with injury into August
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Will Smith's neck injury could "linger into August."
impact: Smith resumed throwing and hitting last week. He has been sidelined since June 11 with a neck injury and remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) activated from IL
desc: The White Sox activated Munetaka Murakami from the injured list.
impact: Murakami makes his return as had been previously reported. He'll be back in the lineup for the final series ahead of the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dan Hammer designated for assignment
desc: The Mets designated Dan Hammer for assignment.
impact: Hammer did not make an appearance after being called up on Thursday. He'll head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ke'Bryan Hayes (back) activated from IL
desc: The Reds activated Ke'Bryan Hayes from the injured list.
impact: Hayes concluded his rehab assignment with a four-hit performance. He makes his return with Matt McLain placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt McLain (calf) placed on IL
desc: The Reds placed Matt McLain on the injured list.
impact: Reds manager Terry Francona described McLain as "a little beat up" with him out of the lineup on Thursday. He'll be on the injured list through the All-Star break.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jacob Gonzalez sent back down
desc: Jacob Gonzalez was optioned back to Triple-A on Friday.
impact: With Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) returning from the IL, Gonzalez will head back to the minors. Gonzalez posted a .244/.323/.360 slash line with two homers and four doubles over 97 plate appearances since debuting on May 31. He'll very likely be seen in the bigs again down the road.

author: Nate Miller
title: JR Ritchie to start Sunday
desc: JR Ritchie will start in the mound in St. Louis on Sunday.
impact: Ritchie was recalled from Triple-A earlier this week and threw 35 pitches over 1 1/3 innings of relief in Thursday's win. Ritchie has made 10 appearances (seven starts) overall for the Braves this year, posting a 4.60 ERA, 1.47 WHIP, and 21.0 K% across 45 innings.
